whyItMatters: Process.Start passes its argument to command execution in csharp, so untrusted input reaching it becomes command injection.
actions: Replace Process.Start with ProcessStartInfo with ArgumentList, passing untrusted data as separate arguments, never interpolated into a command string.
If a shell is required, restrict the command to a fixed allowlist and validate every argument against it.
Re-run the scan and confirm no Process.Start call remains reachable from untrusted input.
verification: Rescan shows no Process.Start reachable from untrusted input, and command tests with metacharacter input execute safely.
